searchText: I don't have a problem with this channel going away, but that is because I don't like meta transactions. 😄 Also, typed-transactions may not be the best place to discuss specific types of transactions, like batched or sponsored. maybe rename this channel to `transactions` or `transactions-dev`? I'd rather co-locate the conversation in <#779922457631916064> and pull it apart later if there's a sub-topic that deserves it's own place for discussion. I'll give this 72 hours to percolate before I archive this channel (speak now if you think this channel needs to be kept around) (I've pulled a text copy of the channel history that I'll save prior to achiving, not sure there's a better mechanism) <@364458974906548225> you can move the channel to the graveyard category. Easy to mute as a whole as user if you're not interested in any of it. Also nice to just move, since it can still be searched in the future.
